role: You are working in the daily-ai-pulse Astro codebase as a front-end implementer.
context:
Visual target: docs/reference-layouts/images/search.webp (Search results concept). Match its layout as closely as possible — this takes priority over any conflicting guidance elsewhere. The image shows:
1. Global header: serif "The Daily AI Pulse" wordmark left, nav (Today / Pulse / Categories / About), a "Search" affordance with icon and a black pill "Subscribe" button right, thin rule below. (Owned by BaseLayout and SearchButton; only verify that no nav item is active on /search/ and that the search affordance is the one that reads as current.) 2. Search head: small-caps tracked terracotta eyebrow ("SEARCH THE PUBLICATION"), very large black display-serif H1 ("Find the signal.") with tight tracking on a single line, then a two-line muted dek (about 55ch wide) below it. Left-aligned, generous whitespace, no illustration. 3. Search form: a visible "Search" label above the field (small, dark, sans). Below it a single row: a wide input with a left-aligned magnifier icon, thin border, 4px-ish radius and light surface fill; then a dark (--ink) "Search" button of the same height with the same radius, separated by a small gap. The row spans roughly the left 80% of the content width, not the full width. A full-width ink/line rule sits below the form. 4. Results status: small-caps tracked bold muted label ("3 RESULTS") directly under the rule, above the list. 5. Result rows, one per hit, separated by thin bottom rules, no card backgrounds. Each row is a two-column grid: - Main column: small-caps tracked terracotta desk label ("SECURITY"), a regular-weight serif title (~2rem, one line on desktop, tight leading), then a two-line muted sans excerpt (~60ch max). - Meta column (about 20% width) with a thin vertical divider on its left: tiny bold tracked "EVIDENCE" label, the evidence level beneath in regular text, then a small-caps tracked muted monospace-ish date ("OCT 28, 2024"). 6. "Explore more" footer row below the last result, under a thin rule: small-caps tracked muted "EXPLORE MORE" label followed by three terracotta text links with a trailing arrow ("Research →", "Dev Tools →", "AI Engineering →"), evenly spaced on one line. 7. Palette/type: warm beige canvas, black display serif for H1/titles, muted gray for dek/excerpt/meta, terracotta only for eyebrow, desk labels, and explore links; --ink for the button and input text.
Known mismatches to resolve: - The image's text is generated and fabricated (headlines, excerpts, dates like "2024"/"2025", "3 RESULTS", the "agent security" query, evidence labels such as "Research report"/"Technical analysis"). Per IMAGE_GALLERY.md, do NOT copy it. Every title, excerpt, desk, evidence level, date, and count must come from the real index/content. - The image's desk labels (Security, AI Engineering, Dev Tools) and "Explore more" links are not guaranteed to be the site taxonomy. Use real category titles from src/lib/categories.ts; choose Explore-more links from real categories (e.g. the categories of the current results, falling back to the first three desks when there are no results). Do not hard-code them. - The image's evidence labels are free text; the site uses the schema `evidence` enum from src/content.config.ts. Render the enum's display label, not invented phrases. - The image shows a populated state only. Keep and style the existing empty prompt ("Enter a term..."), searching, no-results, and development "index not built" states.
Current implementation (inspect before editing, do not redo): - src/pages/search/index.astro already has a form, `#search-status` (aria-live), `#search-results`, and a client script that calls Pagefind (`pagefind/pagefind.js`), then builds `.search-result` articles with an eyebrow ("PULSE"/"STORY" guessed from title), h2 link, and excerpt. Eyebrow is "ARCHIVE SEARCH", H1 is "Search Pulse", the label is sr-only, there is no icon, no meta column, no explore-more row, and the content column is capped at 860px. - Nothing in src/ sets `data-pagefind-*` attributes, so Pagefind exposes only title, url, and excerpt. Desk, evidence level, and date must be added as Pagefind metadata on the story page template (find it under src/pages/stories/) with `data-pagefind-meta` (e.g. category, evidence, date), keeping the existing index behavior (do not exclude or reorder indexed body content). Daily-edition pages that appear in results have no evidence level; render their meta column gracefully (e.g. "EDITION" label plus date) rather than an empty or fabricated value. - tests/e2e/smoke.spec.ts depends on `#search-status` containing /result/i and `.search-result` being visible for `search/?q=agent`. Keep both working.
task: Align the /search/ page with search.webp section by section: update src/pages/search/index.astro (markup, client rendering, scoped styles), add the Pagefind meta attributes to the story page template, and adjust src/components/SearchButton.astro or src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro only if needed for the header state. Result rows must be built with DOM APIs (textContent), never innerHTML, and excerpt markup must stay stripped as it is today.
constraints: - Match column proportions, spacing, divider, and type hierarchy as closely as the image shows. Result title weight is regular, not bold; H1 is a single line at desktop width (replace the current `max-width: 10ch`). - Copy changes: eyebrow "SEARCH THE PUBLICATION", H1 "Find the signal.", dek written in the site voice about searching stories by topic, tool, or company. Do not copy the image's other text. - Status line: "{N} result(s)" in small caps with correct singular/plural; keep the query available to screen readers (e.g. sr-only "for “query”") and keep the aria-live behavior. - Form: visible label tied to the input via for/id, input keeps type="search" and name="q", icon is decorative (aria-hidden), button remains type="submit". Input and button must be 44px+ tall with visible keyboard focus. - Reuse existing design tokens (--terracotta, --ink, --muted, --line, --surface, --canvas); do not introduce new colors. - Base path: all links, including result URLs and Explore-more links, go through import.meta.env.BASE_URL / the categories helper; do not hard-code root-relative paths. - Accessibility: one h1; each result is an `article` with an h2 link; meta column labelled so "Evidence" and the date are readable in order; dates use `` when a valid ISO date is available; decorative arrows aria-hidden; no color-only distinction; axe must pass. - Responsive: below tablet width, stack the form (input above button, full width) and collapse each result to one column with the meta column moving under the excerpt as an inline row (divider becomes a top rule); no horizontal overflow. - Do not modify files under docs/reference-layouts/. Do not add features beyond the image (no filters, facets, sorting, pagination, or autocomplete); keep the existing 30-result cap. - Run npm run check, npm run lint, npm run format:check, npm run build, and the e2e smoke and accessibility specs (npx playwright test tests/e2e/smoke.spec.ts tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts); fix any failure you introduced.
